description: This file defines extension methods to configure cookie-related security settings for an ASP.NET Core web application, including setting cookie policies, application cookie options, and registering related services.

classes.name: ConfigureCookieSettings
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure cookie security and policy settings in an ASP.NET Core application.

methods.name: AddCookieSettings
methods.description: Extension method that configures cookie policies and application cookie options, and registers the RevokeAuthenticationEvents service.
